title: program/evidence/<ID>/acceptance/<utc>-<sha256[:12]>.json
description: A QA acceptance bound to one results record (by digest) and the commit it was verified at, appended by `pk evidence accept` (which refuses one that does not bind the latest results record) and never modified; a re-acceptance appends a new one. Documents the shape for readers. Setting a task to done requires every listed key, the decision accepted_development, the role qa and the task's own ID.

evidence_sha256.description: digest (sha256 of the bytes) of the results record that was reviewed: the task's latest

commands.description: the commands QA re-ran, in the results record's command shape

planted_bugs.description: the planted bugs QA re-ran, in the results record's row shape
